title: ContinuityTracker Event
description: Append-only bible fact log. Every prose assertion that establishes a canonical fact about the story world is recorded here. Used by ContinuityAgent to detect contradictions. Covers characters, locations, objects, timeline, and world-facts.

fact_type.description: Entity category this fact belongs to. Determines which contradiction detectors apply.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity this fact is about (character_id, location_id, object_id, etc.).

entity_name.description: Human-readable name for display (denormalized from the entity record).

fact_key.description: Dot-notation key identifying what is being asserted (e.g. 'eye_color', 'location.city', 'job_title', 'age').

fact_value.description: The asserted value. Type varies by fact_key; validated during Phase 7 implementation.

source_scene.description: Scene ID where this fact was first established. Used by contradiction detection to surface the conflicting scene.

confidence.description: Confidence that this fact is canonical (1.0 = explicitly stated; lower = inferred). Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.

supersedes_event_id.description: If this event corrects a prior fact, the event_id of the prior record. Null for new facts. Ledger is append-only; prior records are never deleted.
